x: Our lads performed equally well, Our first win was in of all things the Youth's Shot putt, Dave Raffell reaching 11 metres with the 10lb ball.
Peter Carton won the senior 800m. title in his section in 1m. 58.9s., while Reg Hopkins cleared 5' 9" for a high-jump victory, and Dave Raffell accomplished 11.99m. for a first in the shot-putt.
He only needs to record a somewhat faster time. Fourth place in the intermediate 1,500m. went to Simon Holmes in 4m. 19s., while Dave Raffell was fourth in the intermediate shot.

Reg Hopkins was a double winner in the youths' events, taking the pentathlon and the high-jump, while in this section, we also won the long-jump, through Stephen Crosbie, the shot-putt, through Dave Raffell, and the 800m., through fast-improving Dave Harvey.
